##### Project general facts

Sunrise Haven is an exclusive collection of luxury three-bedroom townhouses set within the prestigious AIDA community in Muscat, Oman. Perched high above Muscat Bay, the development enjoys breathtaking panoramic views of the Arabian Sea and the surrounding golf course, creating a unique lifestyle where coastal beauty and contemporary architecture exist in perfect harmony. Designed with spacious open-plan layouts and elegant interiors, each townhouse offers a seamless blend of comfort, sophistication, and timeless design, making Sunrise Haven an exceptional choice for both homeowners and investors.

Residents enjoy a tranquil resort-inspired lifestyle surrounded by world-class leisure and natural beauty. The elevated location provides a peaceful retreat with refreshing sea breezes, while the prestigious AIDA community offers easy access to championship golf, premium hospitality, and a variety of recreational experiences. Whether as a permanent residence, a holiday home, or an investment property, Sunrise Haven delivers an exceptional living environment defined by privacy, luxury, and spectacular surroundings.

The townhouses are finished with premium-quality materials and feature state-of-the-art smart home automation systems that enhance comfort and convenience. Every residence has been thoughtfully designed with elegant interiors that combine modern functionality with refined aesthetics. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, and each townhouse is delivered fully furnished, offering a move-in-ready home or a turnkey vacation rental with outstanding attention to detail.

##### Location description and benefits

Oman, a land of timeless beauty and cultural richness, lies on the southeastern tip of the Arabian Peninsula. Bordered by the Arabian Sea, the Gulf of Oman, and the Rub' al Khali desert, Oman is a country where ancient traditions meet modern aspirations. Its stunning landscapes, hospitable people, and well-preserved heritage make it a unique and captivating destination.

Oman boasts an incredibly diverse terrain that ranges from golden deserts to lush green oases, rugged mountains, and pristine coastlines. The Al Hajar Mountains dominate the northern landscape, offering breathtaking vistas, hidden villages, and adventure opportunities such as hiking and canyoning. 

In stark contrast, the Empty Quarter, the world’s largest sand desert, exudes an ethereal beauty that captivates travelers. Oman’s 3,165-kilometer coastline is dotted with secluded beaches, turquoise waters, and dramatic cliffs, making it a paradise for beachgoers and water sports enthusiasts alike.
